Messages.Author: Chris Arthur
Messages.Body:
If an infernal vampire has a homunculus can you tap the vampire in
your untap phase to avoid paying a pool and then untap him with the
homunculus? i assume yes.

Chris.

Messages.Author: X_Zealot
Messages.Body:
"Chris Arthur" <chr...@comcen.com.au> wrote in message
news:5a63bace.01112...@posting.google.com...

> If an infernal vampire has a homunculus can you tap the vampire in
> your untap phase to avoid paying a pool and then untap him with the
> homunculus? i assume yes.

Of course you could. Inferrnal if you read it occurs during your untap phase
which is the same phase as infernal occurs. You may order your untap phase
as you wish so you could pay the blood rather than the pool.

Messages.Author: GreySeer
Messages.Body:
"Chris Arthur" <chr...@comcen.com.au> wrote in message
news:5a63bace.01112...@posting.google.com...

> If an infernal vampire has a homunculus can you tap the vampire in
> your untap phase to avoid paying a pool and then untap him with the
> homunculus? i assume yes.

Homunculus
Retainer with 1 life. [pro] During any Methuselah's untap phase, the vampire
with this retainer can burn 1 blood to untap. [PRO] As above, but Homunculus
has 2 life.

It says any so that includes yours and you can order effects in any way you
like ( with the exception of the "default" untap which has to be at the
start of your untap phase ). So in actual fact what happens is that your
infernal minion untaps, you then decide wether to pay the 1 pool cost, which
in this case we're assuming you aren't, the infernal minion taps and then
you pay one blood and untap him ( again ).

A nice way of getting around paying the 1 pool but not so good if you've
got, say, Charnas the Pimp because you've untapped twice and therefore take
2 damage.

I think you are wrong here, the rule for Infernal minions is that you
must pay one pool TO untap them, not to avoid taping them ! So your
vampire only untapped once (thanks to the homonculus)

> in this case we're assuming you aren't, the infernal minion taps and then
> you pay one blood and untap him ( again ).

Not 'again' as I pointed above

> A nice way of getting around paying the 1 pool but not so good if you've
> got, say, Charnas the Pimp because you've untapped twice and therefore take
> 2 damage.

Nope, same reason
